day2_night_phone_1.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_1.text: *The old school group chat. 'Read by 3'. Nobody replied. Two days now.*

day2_night_phone_2.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_2.text: *I sent Minsu a message. 'Hey Minsu, I transferred and you haven't even hit me up lol'*

day2_night_phone_3.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_3.text: *10 minutes later. The '...' indicator appeared. Minsu is typing.*

day2_night_phone_4.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_4.text: *5 seconds. The typing indicator keeps blinking. Is he writing a long message?*

day2_night_phone_7.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_7.text: *...What is this. The guy who normally starts with 'hey you idiot lmaooo' and a string of insults is being this stiff?*

day2_night_phone_8.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_8.text: *'Yeah doing well.' ...That's what he picked after 5 seconds of typing?*

day2_night_phone_9.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_9.text: *I replied. 'Why so formal lol, something up?'*

day2_night_phone_10.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_10.text: *1 minute. 2 minutes. The typing indicator appears again.*

day2_night_phone_11.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_11.text: *Minsu: 'Nah nothing's up lol just been busy'*

day2_night_phone_12.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_12.text: *...Something about his tone feels different. Must just be busy.*

day2_night_phone_13.speaker: me
day2_night_phone_13.text: *...I want to ask more. I'll try replying to Minsu.*
choices: Check the old group chat again
Put the phone down and think

day2_night_ft_messenger.speaker: me
day2_night_ft_messenger.text: *I shot back. 'Yo Minsu, is that really you? lol Doesn't sound like you, what's going on?'*

day2_night_ft_messenger_2.speaker: me
day2_night_ft_messenger_2.text: *Typing indicator. Blinking forever. Five seconds, ten, twenty.*

day2_night_ft_messenger_3.speaker: me
day2_night_ft_messenger_3.text: *Minsu: 'Yeah it's me. Just sleepy, that's all.'*

day2_night_ft_messenger_4.speaker: me
day2_night_ft_messenger_4.text: *...Twenty seconds of typing, and that's what he ended up sending.*

day2_night_ft_messenger_5.speaker: me
day2_night_ft_messenger_5.text: *Off, somehow. But if he says he's sleepy, what can I do. I'll ask again later. I put the phone down.*

day2_night_sea_1.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_1.text: *Sea: 'Thanks for today too. For coming to the student council room.'*

day2_night_sea_4.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_4.text: *I reply. 'I had fun today too. Good luck with sports day prep lol'*

day2_night_sea_5.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_5.text: *Sea: 'Good luck? lol You're the one who has to help me'*

day2_night_sea_9_alt.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_9_alt.text: *Sea: 'Then I'll see you at school tomorrow. Don't stay up too late.'*

day2_night_sea_9.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_9.text: *Sea: 'But you remember the promise from lunch today, right?'*

day2_night_sea_14.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_14.text: *I put the phone down. The moon is out the window. Another KakaoTalk notification buzzes.*

day2_night_sea_14a.speaker: me
day2_night_sea_14a.text: *A message came through the Student Safety App.*

day2_night_eunsu_1.speaker: me
day2_night_eunsu_1.text: *Eunsu: '{name}, you did well on your presentation today. You're adapting fast.'*

day2_night_eunsu_2.speaker: me
day2_night_eunsu_2.text: *Eunsu: 'Can you stop by the teachers' office tomorrow? There's a document I need to check.'*

day2_night_eunsu_5.speaker: me
day2_night_eunsu_5.text: *...The teacher even sends messages like this. My old homeroom teacher couldn't even remember my name.*

day2_night_flash_1.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_1.text: *I lie under the covers and close my eyes.*

day2_night_flash_2.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_2.text: *...Suddenly, an image flashed. Walking down this school's corridor. It's raining. My uniform is wet. Running with someone —*

day2_night_flash_3.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_3.text: *Holding hands. A girl's hand. A cold hand.*

day2_night_flash_4.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_4.text: *"This way" — someone's voice. One I feel like I've heard before.*

day2_night_flash_5.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_5.text: *I open my eyes. There's sweat on my forehead.*

day2_night_flash_6.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_6.text: *...What was that just now? It wasn't a dream, but an image surfaced. This school's corridor... as if I've walked it before. Running while holding someone's hand. A cold hand.*

day2_night_flash_7.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_7.text: *...Eunsu? Her hand was cold when she patted my shoulder earlier. ...No, that can't be related.*

day2_night_flash_8.speaker: me
day2_night_flash_8.text: *...It's probably because I'm still tense from the first day. My head is full of school images.*

day2_night_search_1.speaker: me
day2_night_search_1.text: *...Kicked off my blanket and got up. Couldn't sleep. Grabbed my phone. Typed 'Haedoji High School' into the search bar.*

day2_night_search_2.speaker: me
day2_night_search_2.text: *Official website. Principal's message. School history. The graduation album link? — 'Under construction.' Ms. Eunsu and Nurse Riin's names were on the staff list. No photos, though.*

day2_night_search_3.speaker: me
day2_night_search_3.text: *News search. 'Haedoji High School.' No results. Nothing. Not even in local news. — A school this size, and not a single news article?*

day2_night_search_4.speaker: me
day2_night_search_4.text: *'Haedodigo Festival', 'Haedodigo Graduation Ceremony'. Nothing. Weird. Every school usually has at least one sports festival photo online, right?*

day2_night_search_5.speaker: me
day2_night_search_5.text: *...Am I digging too deep? Is this just how it is for small schools? I put my phone down and lay back down.*

day2_night_dream_1.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_1.text: *I close my eyes again. This time, I fall asleep.*

day2_night_dream_3.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_3.text: *A classroom. But not the current one. The desk arrangement is different. There's a date written on the blackboard but I can't read it.*

day2_night_dream_4.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_4.text: *Someone is sitting in the front seat. Long hair. I can only see their back.*

day2_night_dream_6.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_6.text: *The person turns around. It's Seolhwa. But Seolhwa's expression is different. The Seolhwa now is always sad, but the Seolhwa in the dream — is smiling.*

day2_night_dream_7.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_7.text: *Seolhwa opens her mouth. She's saying something but I can't hear. I try to read her lips. 'Hel—' She's saying something.*

day2_night_dream_7a.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_7a.text: *I tried to read her lips. 'Hel—' She's saying something.*

day2_night_dream_8.speaker: me
day2_night_dream_8.text: *The classroom grows dark. Seolhwa's face blurs.*

day2_night_wake_2.speaker: me
day2_night_wake_2.text: *...A dream? Seolhwa was in it. She was smiling. She was trying to say something...*

day2_night_wake_3.speaker: me
day2_night_wake_3.text: *I can't remember. What she said. ...It was just a dream.*
